title: Future Glory
definition: Future glory is the promised completion of salvation when believers are fully transformed and share in the joy of Christ's eternal kingdom.
summary: Present suffering is real, but it is not the final word. God will complete His work and reveal glory beyond comparison.
christFocus: Christ will return in glory and make His people like Himself.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Present suffering is real, but it is not the final word. God will complete His work and reveal glory beyond comparison.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
